body_text:
The singleton connective sets consisting only of NAND
($\{\barwedge\}$) or only of NOR ($\{\downarrow\}$) are
*functionally complete*: every Boolean truth function of any
number of variables can be expressed using formulas containing
that single connective alone.

Functional completeness guarantees that our logical universe lacks
nothing in expressive reach. In subsequent chapters, when we speak
of mathematical definitions, properties, and constraints, we do so
with the certainty that any finite truth condition can be
formulated rigorously within the language of propositional logic.
